Name: Kwaaal's Floating Farm
Author: Kwaaal
Description:
Inspired by Emily❤️💙

💐 初始版本与可替换背景板的区别：
初始版本使用daisyniko‘s tilesheet的素材作为天空背景，因为制作方式限制，如果大家想用自己的背景图就会出现图片卡壳的情况，现在提供可替换背景版本，初始版和可替换背景版会同步更新。

💐 Differences Between the Base Version and Replaceable Background Version:
The base version uses assets from daisyniko's tilesheet as the sky background. Due to technical limitations in the original design, custom background images may appear glitchy.
To address this,  a Replaceable Background version now is offered , allowing you to freely customize the backdrop. Both versions (Base and Replaceable Background) will receive synchronized updates moving forward.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
💐 替换背景说明：
- 在可替换背景版的assets/Panorama文件夹中，用想要的图片替换文件夹对应的图片；
-‼️注意： 1. 图片的尺寸必须是 1680x2400像素；2. 图片名字不能做修改！

💐 Custom Background Instructions:
- To customize the background in Replaceable Background version, replace the corresponding images in the `assets/Panorama` folder with your desired pictures.
‼️Important Notes:
1. Image dimensions must be 1680x2400 pixels;    
2. Do not modify the original file names.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
